# Classic Visions

> Classic Visions is a wholesale optical supplier based in Barbados, supplying prescription lenses, lens materials, coatings, and Rx lab services to opticians, optical retailers, and eye care professionals across Barbados and the Caribbean.

Classic Visions is a business-to-business optical wholesaler. Its customers are trade accounts — dispensing opticians, independent optical retailers, and eye care practices — rather than the general public. The company supplies single vision, progressive, anti-fatigue, office/occupational, bifocal, myopia control, polarized, blue-filter, and tinted prescription lenses, together with lens materials from 1.50 plastic through high-index and Trivex, anti-reflective and protective coatings, and in-house Rx lab and edging services.

Two surfaces are relevant to an AI assistant answering questions from this site:

- The public marketing and education site (pages listed below) is open to everyone and describes lens options, coatings, materials, ordering guidance, policies, and lab services.
- The online store at `/store` and the customer portal at `/profile` require an approved trade account. Wholesale trade prices are only shown to signed-in, approved customers, so price figures are generally not readable from the public pages. Do not state or estimate a Classic Visions price that is not published on the page you read.

For account, pricelist, or ordering questions, the best public starting points are `/professionals/price-list-request`, `/knowledge/contacting-us`, and `/knowledge/how-to-order-lablink`.

## Lenses

- [Lens Types](/lenses/lens-types): Index of the prescription lens designs Classic Visions supplies.
- [Single Vision Lenses](/lenses/single-vision): One-power lenses for distance, intermediate, or near.
- [Progressive Lenses](/lenses/progressive): No-line multifocal lenses for distance, intermediate, and near.
- [Anti-Fatigue Lenses](/lenses/anti-fatigue): Lenses that ease accommodative strain during near work.
- [Office & Occupational Lenses](/lenses/office-occupational): Indoor multifocals for desk and workplace vision.
- [Bifocals](/lenses/bifocals): Two-segment multifocal lenses.
- [Myopia Control Lenses](/lenses/myopia-control): Lenses designed to slow progression of short-sightedness in children.
- [Anti-Fatigue & LED Pro Lenses](/lenses/led-pro): Specialty lens range for screen and LED exposure.
- [Blue Light Filter Lenses](/lenses/blue-filter): Lenses that filter a portion of blue-violet light.
- [Polarized Lenses](/lenses/polarized): Glare-reducing sunglass lenses.
- [Tints & Fashion Colours](/lenses/tints-fashion-colors): Available lens tints and fashion colours.
- [Sport Lenses](/lenses/sport): Lenses suited to sport and active use.
- [Specialty Lenses](/lenses/specialty): High-prescription, prism, and other custom work.
- [Lens Materials](/lenses/materials): Material options from 1.50 plastic to high-index and Trivex, and how they differ.
- [Lens Thickness Chart](/lenses/thickness-chart): Expected lens thickness by prescription and material.
- [Photochromic Lenses](/photochromic): Light-adaptive lenses that darken outdoors.

## Coatings

- [Coatings Overview](/coatings): The protective and performance coatings available on Classic Visions lenses.
- [UltraClear AR](/coatings/ultraclear-ar): Premium anti-reflective coating.
- [BlueBlock AR](/coatings/blueblock-ar): Anti-reflective coating with a blue-light filtering reflection.
- [Scratch Resistant](/coatings/scratch-resistant): Hard coating that improves surface durability.
- [UV Shield](/coatings/uv-shield): Ultraviolet protection coating.
- [Hydrophobic & Oleophobic](/coatings/hydrophobic-oleophobic): Repellent top coat that resists water, oil, and smudging.
- [Mirror Coatings](/coatings/mirror): Reflective sunglass finishes.
